behavior: A statement PDF proves a profile's income for a period: invoice payments and income-labelled money in, with USD and records currency values and totals
acceptance: GET /v1/profiles/{id}/statement.pdf?from=&to= returns a PDF for those UTC days; both days are required, from after to is 422, no billing details is 404 billing_details_not_found; another user 403.

It lists income oldest first (invoice payments with invoice number and client, money in labelled income), each with UTC time, network, token amount, USD value to the cent and the transaction hash with its explorer link.
With a records currency each line adds its value, and totals add the rounded lines; when a line has no rate the other total is left out with a note; a note counts the unclassified money in left out.
The header shows the billing details as account holder, the period and the issue time; the same input gives the same bytes; R-112, api.md and openapi.yaml describe it; the route is in the 403 test.
notes: 2026-10-19 review fail by reviewer: Blockers (all in the statement's page layout, apps/backend/internal/document/statement.go): (1) statement.go:134-145: the total row has no page check, and row() puts each cell with SetXY at the old y. When the last row ends near the bottom margin (every 14th row on a continuation page, e.g. 23 or 37 lines), fpdf breaks the page once per cell: a blank page, then 'Total', the USD total and the EUR total each on its own page (23 lines gave 6 pages instead of 3; reproduced with an overlay test). Fix: pageFor(2+lineHeight) before the rule and total, and a regression test that renders 1..40 lines and requires Total and both totals on one page. (2) statement.go:81-96 and :102: the column header is drawn once; rows on page 2+ have no header, so the USD and records-currency columns are two bare numbers nobody can tell apart. Fix: draw the header in a closure and redraw it whenever the row loop starts a new page. (3) statement.go:57-61 and :136-142: totals are not fitted to their 25 mm cells. Measured: '1,600,000,000.00 IDR' 33.6 mm, '36,000,000.00 HUF' 29.8 mm, '140,000,000 KRW' 27.7 mm. Right-aligned text spills left, so at 100,000 USD income in IDR the totals print over each other ('100,000.00 U$,600,000,000.00 IDR'). Fix: print totals with plain() like the lines (the header names the currency) and widen the number columns, or wrap them with d.fit as lines() does. Minor: (a) moneyapi/activity.go:301,305 and statement.go: USD cents and records minor units are int64 with ParseInt errors ignored; the root rule says money is *big.Int. Overflow is unreachable for real stablecoin amounts, but *big.Int removes the ignored errors. (b) statement.go:126-130 repeats TxURL (document.go:68); use it. (c) openapi.yaml:928 writes the 404 inline; reuse #/components/responses/BillingDetailsNotFound. (d) R-112 does not say confirmed; api.md and openapi do. Add it to R-112. (e) TestStatement cannot tell 'sum of rounded lines' from 'rounded sum' (7.234567 rounds to 7.23 both ways), has no half-cent case and never asserts a complete records total. Add e.g. two 1.005 USDC income lines (2.02 USD) and a period where every line has a rate. (f) document.go open(): the moved comment still says 'kind and number'; it is now the label. Checked OK: open() keeps invoice, receipt and canceled-invoice bytes equal to main (same sha256 on both trees); half-up cents via FloatString(0); JPY/KRW/ISK 0-decimal parsing; slices.Backward gives oldest first; UTC day range and To label; confirmed-only fits proof of income; profile-scoped SQL, the 403 test and Cache-Control no-store; determinism holds for the same Statement (the issue time is part of the input, as R-112 requires). Scope: AllTransfers loads the whole range with no limit, as the R-108 CSV already does; only invoice or user-labelled lines are drawn, so dust spam only raises the unclassified count. Go tests pass.

2026-10-19 review fail by reviewer: Re-review. The first round's three blockers and six minor points are fixed, except one hole in the header fix. Blocker: apps/backend/internal/document/statement.go:140-141. d.pageFor(2 + lineHeight + 2) can start a new page for the rule and the total, and nothing draws the header there. Totals now print with plain() and no currency, so that page shows 'Total 900,000.00 14,400,000,000.00' with no column names: the same unlabelled-numbers defect as blocker 2, now on the totals. Reproduced with the test's own statement(n) fixture (IDR): 9 lines with 1 or 2 extra address lines, and 8 lines with 4 or 5. Page 2 then holds only the rule, Total, two bare numbers and the notes. It happens when the first page's last row ends within 9 mm of the bottom margin, so the cases are 8-9-line statements. Fix: when the total does not fit, AddPage() and header(), as the row loop does, or keep the last row with the total. Extend checkStatementPages so the page with 'Total' must also contain 'Date (UTC)'. That fails today at 9 lines with 1 extra address line, inside the test's existing range. Minor: (a) statement_test.go:88-89 says the widest totals fit their columns, but the test checks no widths: drop the clause or assert it. (b) A note can leave one line alone on the last page (8 lines, no extra address: page 2 holds only 'edited: each transaction can be checked...'). It is cosmetic: pageFor the whole note keeps it together. (c) row() stops shrinking at 6 pt, so a wider number would still spill. Real amounts never reach that. Checked OK: the total no longer breaks per cell. The header repeats in the row loop. Totals and lines fit; the two-page sample shows 1,500,000.00 next to 24,000,000,000.00. Money is *big.Int with no ignored parse errors (SetString of FloatString output cannot fail). TxURL is reused, openapi reuses BillingDetailsNotFound, and R-112, api.md and the notes say confirmed. TestStatement's 1.005 pair proves the totals are sums of the rounded lines (2.02 USD and 1.60 EUR, not 2.01 and 1.61), with a complete EUR total; 9.25 is right. open() changed only a comment since the byte check, so invoice and receipt bytes still match main. Go tests pass (document, httpapi, tests, activity).

2026-10-19 review pass by reviewer: Third review: pass. The last blocker is fixed. When the rule and total do not fit, statement.go now calls AddPage() and header(), so a moved total sits under the column names. checkStatementPages requires 'Date (UTC)' on the page with 'Total'. A probe of 2,852 renders found no page breaks without a header and no split or missing total: IDR and no records currency, 0 to 45 lines, 0 to 30 extra address lines, with no-rate and unclassified notes. Notes stay whole. Minor, not blocking: (a) with 8 lines and no extra address lines, the 'NOTES' heading ends page 1 alone and its first note starts page 2. heading() keeps 15 mm, but a 2-line note needs 16 mm after the heading. Fix if wanted: before the heading, pageFor the heading plus the first note. (b) row()'s 6 pt font floor stays, which is fine for real amounts. Still OK from earlier rounds: money is *big.Int and rounds half up, and totals add the rounded lines (1.005 pair: 2.02 USD and 1.60 EUR). Lines are oldest first and confirmed only, with UTC days. The holder is the billing details, and the route is profile-scoped with the 403 test. Invoice and receipt bytes are unchanged. openapi, api.md and R-112 match. Go tests pass (document, httpapi, tests, activity).

2026-10-19 review pass by reviewer: Fourth review: pass. The last minor point is fixed. Before the Notes heading, statement.go keeps room for the heading and its first note (pageFor(3*lineHeight + first note's lines)). The font is set first, so the line count matches what is drawn. checkStatementPages fails when a page ends with the NOTES heading alone. A probe of 2,852 renders found no page that ends with NOTES, INCOME or the column header alone, no empty page, no rows or total without the header, and exactly one total each time. It covered IDR and no records currency, 0 to 45 lines, 0 to 30 extra address lines, and the no-rate and unclassified notes. Nothing else changed since the third review, and its findings hold. Not changed by choice: the 6 pt font floor in row(), fine for real amounts. Go tests pass (document, httpapi, tests, activity).

proof.1: unit: TestStatement: 200 application/pdf for 2025-10-01..31; a missing from or to, from after to and bad days are 422; the merchant profile without billing details is 404 billing_details_not_found; the route is in profileRoutes (403).
proof.2: unit: TestStatement's PDF text lists INV-0001 · Bob Ltd, Income and the later income oldest first, with UTC times, '5.00 USDC on Base Sepolia', USD 5.00 and 1.23 and each hash; it leaves out the unclassified, the money out, the still confirming and the earlier transfer.
proof.3: unit: TestStatement: EUR 4.00 and 0.99, 'no rate', total 9.25 with '—' and the note, '1 payment in is unclassified'; two 1.005 USDC lines total 2.02 USD and 1.60 EUR. TestStatementPagesKeepTheTableTogether (1-40 lines, 4 holder heights): the total with both amounts under the header on one page, the header on every page that lists payments, the notes' heading never alone at a page end; each rule fails its mutation.
proof.4: unit: TestStatement shows ACCOUNT HOLDER Alice Design GmbH, Tax ID and the period; TestStatementIsTheSameEachTime renders the same bytes twice; R-112, api.md and openapi.yaml describe it; samples docs/runs/F244-statement-sample.pdf and F244-statement-two-pages.pdf.
